# Company job feeds

Verified public feeds (Nov 2026), mostly US tech companies with design teams. Use these as a starting list for `jobpot scan`; add companies that fit the user's field. A slug is usually the company name in lowercase; `notFound` in the scan output means that company uses a different system or slug.

Copy-paste scan (60 companies, about 5 seconds):

```
jobpot scan greenhouse:airbnb,figma,stripe,databricks,discord,dropbox,pinterest,asana,robinhood,gusto,samsara,coinbase,anthropic,scaleai,brex,instacart,lyft,twilio,okta,affirm,chime,waymo,verkada,mercury,webflow,airtable,intercom,faire,checkr,gleanwork,lattice,flexport,doordashusa,reddit,squarespace,nextdoor ashby:ramp,notion,linear,openai,vercel,replit,cursor,harvey,perplexity,deel,sierra,decagon,writer,elevenlabs,supabase,posthog,watershed,modal,cohere,runway,mercor lever:palantir,spotify,zoox
```

Not on these systems (skip): grammarly, vanta, benchling, navan, retool, glean (ashby), clay, hebbia, matterport, leandata, plaid, attentive.
